source_evidence: Exact player 'Yes, what Cirren said' endorses Cirren's specific request that Voss suspend collection of dues until the rival claim is resolved. Predeclared V Persuasion +7 with advantage from Cirren's meaningful Help (argument and already corroborated records), DC15 for immediate suspension order. Actual executed visible Python secrets batch 783b63f69577cd2bd33a49fd947be3c9 faces9,6 keep9+7=16 success. Voss voluntarily agrees to suspend collections within his own station's administrative remit pending Lady Caul's resolution of claim. He writes and seals an order to that effect; directs existing hall Guard to deliver it to three-man collection patrol immediately. Hall Guard accepts and departs tower at ~16:05 D333, ordinary six rough miles on foot approximately4h toward road point, earliest arrival~20:05 if no delay and patrol remains accessible; no receipt, compliance, new report, wider suspension, permanent cessation, restitution, confiscated property returned beyond prior actual grain release, general safe passage guarantee, bounty, legal adjudication or title transfer established. Do not add courier or replacement guard: tower now has gate Guard, roof Scout, upstairs Spy, Voss; one hall Guard en route; 3 road patrol retainers last known collection point, actual future whereabouts/reaction unresolved. Voss expresses concern employer will disapprove but chooses suspension; no message or meeting with Caul arranged yet. Voss offers to arrange audience as previously stated; V chooses response. No V extra speech, spending, movement or resources. Time D333~16:05. No combat.
